result.note: Expectation count is the observed testthat count from this fresh run; earlier ledger text quoted a different count for an earlier version of the test file.

oracle: Dense exact Gaussian marginal likelihood (MVN with Zs diag(tau) K diag(tau) Zs' + sigma^2 I) and an independent L-BFGS-B optimum, both computed in the test. Independence: partly independent. The relmat (Toeplitz) and animal (geometric) kernels are analytic and independent of the code under test; the spatial oracle and data-generating covariance use drmTMB:::drm_spatial_coords_precision (the helper under test), whose name alignment is checked only against a kernel rebuilt with the same formula (mirrored, not independent).
tolerances_copied_from_test: dense oracle logLik 1e-6 (relative); independent L-BFGS-B optimum 1e-5 (relative); SD prediction identity 1e-10 / saved-model prediction 1e-12; constant-SD vs base logLik 2e-5; kernel rebuild 1e-8; positional kernel/precision must differ by >0.2 (relmat, animal) or >0.5 (spatial precision); positional oracle logLik must differ by >1000 x (1e-6 x |logLik|); smoke recovery |z-0.4|<0.4
scope: Native Gaussian mu with relmat(1 | id, K = K) and sd(id, level='relmat') ~ z; spatial(1 | site, coords = coords) and sd(site, level='spatial') ~ z; animal(0 + x | id, A = A) slope-only with sd(id, level='animal', coef='x') ~ z. Not covered: Q/Ainv/pedigree inputs, slope SDs for relmat and spatial, multi-coefficient blocks, sigma regression, se=TRUE inference, profile targets, non-Gaussian families (not tested, not fenced).
limits: fixed-seed fixtures with loose recovery bands where applicable
